metadata.title: Retro Backlit Portrait with Block Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A dramatic close-up portrait featuring intense rim lighting on voluminous hair and a dark, moody background paired with bold, stacked slab-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, soft-focus male portrait with a large, textured hairstyle illuminated by a strong golden backlight that creates a halo effect. The subject is set against a dark, indistinct background, with bold, red and blue block lettering positioned in the upper left corner, framed by horizontal rules.
coreVisualRelationships: The golden rim light defines the silhouette against the deep black background.
The heavy, red typography provides a sharp geometric contrast to the soft, organic textures of the hair.
The low-key lighting on the face creates a moody, intimate atmosphere.
coreInvariants: Stacked typography with horizontal divider lines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale head and shoulders portrait, centered horizontally, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing halo of the hair acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright typography in the top left, move down the glowing edge of the hair, and settle on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space on the right and bottom to emphasize the lighting effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark background and the bright, saturated highlights and text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with square proportions
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars extending from the top and bottom of the text block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, secondary line in a similar slab serif style but in a contrasting color (Cyan) and smaller scale.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rules framing the text blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif and square proportions.
Provides the necessary geometric slab feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus portrait of a person with voluminous 80s-style hair, lit with a strong golden rim light against a dark, nearly black background. The face should be in low-key lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, stacked red slab-serif text in the top left corner, followed by a smaller line of cyan slab-serif text. Include thin horizontal red lines above and below the main text block.

verificationChecks: Is the rim light bright and golden?
Is the text stacked and slab-serif?
Is the background dark and out of focus?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: The hair must have a visible glowing edge.
The typography must be legible but heavy.
The overall mood should feel like a late 70s or early 80s studio portrait.
The red text must be the most saturated element.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Rim Light + Stacked Slab Serif Typography
